read: Truist cut NVDA to Hold, target lowered to $174 (09:35). A web search found no primary source; it only showed Truist's earlier Buy ratings. The slide started at the 09:30 open (170 pre-market to 167.2), before the headline, amid the ongoing CEO turmoil. The new $174 target is still above the 163.8 price, so this is a routine rating change on a mega-cap. My two earlier NVDA shorts lost. No trade.

considered.why_not: This is a Hold, not a Sell, and its $174 target sits 6% above the price. About 3.6% of the drop from pre-market came before the headline, so the downgrade is piling onto a CEO-turmoil selloff the market is already pricing. Dip buyers have beaten my NVDA shorts twice, which argues for a mild fade lean. But the selling is still heavy and I couldn't verify the note within a minute, so I'm not trading it.
